items.title: Solana Proposal Would Increase Daily SOL Burns More Than 10-Fold
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increasing daily SOL burns significantly could enhance scarcity, potentially driving up SOL's value and improving market sentiment.

items.title: A new Solana proposal aims to ramp up daily SOL Burns from $47,000 to $650,000
items.whyYouShouldCare: A proposed jump in daily SOL burns to $650,000 could strengthen the token's deflationary mechanics, impacting liquidity and investor interest.

items.title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds on Solana, Ethereum
items.whyYouShouldCare: BlackRock's entry with tokenized money market funds on Solana could attract institutional capital, boosting ecosystem usage and SOL's market positioning.
